integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1]

Photorealistic live-action, cinematic fantasy-thriller style, presented in a 16:9 widescreen composition.

A centered full-body long shot frames a real young adult woman standing alone on a rain-covered skyscraper rooftop at night.

The camera is positioned directly in front of her at eye level.

Her entire body is visible from head to toe.

Her shoulders, body, head, and face point straight toward the camera.

She has short silver-white hair and wears a dark navy tactical coat with subtle cyan illuminated seams, black gloves, and a star-shaped pendant.

A futuristic city stretches far behind her beneath a total solar eclipse.

Strong wind moves her wet hair and long coat naturally.

Rain falls continuously while cyan city lights reflect in the surrounding puddles.

She remains still, breathes naturally, and maintains direct eye contact with the camera.

At 00:05.000, the star-shaped pendant emits one subtle cyan pulse that briefly illuminates the front of her coat.

The camera holds the full-body long shot without changing its distance or frontal angle.


[Shot 2]

At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a frontal close-up from the exact same central viewing axis.

The woman's facial identity, silver-white hairstyle, clothing, pendant, expression, rain, and lighting remain fully consistent with the long shot.

Her face remains square to the camera with no head turn or profile angle.

Rainwater travels across her skin while cool cyan city light illuminates one side of her face.

She blinks once slowly, then raises her gaze slightly toward the eclipse while maintaining direct eye contact.

The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her eyes.

A subtle cyan star-shaped reflection appears inside her right pupil.

The close-up holds until 00:15.000.


overall_soundscape:

Strong rooftop wind, steady rain, distant city alarms, moving fabric, wet hair, natural breathing, subtle electrical ambience, and a slow heartbeat continue across both shots.

A soft electrical pulse sounds when the pendant illuminates, while the environmental audio remains continuous across the cut.


non_diegetic_music:

A sustained low cello note plays beneath sparse piano tones and a restrained synthetic drone.

The texture gradually rises after the pendant pulse, followed by one deep cinematic drum impact during the cut to the close-up and a sustained final note until 00:15.000.
